ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice assistant specifically trained on campus administrative and event guidelines to instantly answer student inquiries.
ideas.title: CampusVoice RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an immediate pain point felt by event organizers and students on campus, fitting the 12-hour build window by focusing on a hyper-local RAG system.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and mess-menu wellness tracker optimized for student dietary constraints and budget.
ideas.title: AuraMeal AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven winning hackathon pattern by delivering a hyper-practical, consumer-facing health utility with a fully working live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced multimodal lost-and-found portal built for the college campus to instantly match uploaded item photos using vision models.
ideas.title: AIRS Lost & Found Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem judges in the host institution experience daily, ensuring high local relevance and immediate comprehension during live judging.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that converts unstructured campus lecture recordings into searchable, timestamped knowledge notes.
ideas.title: LectureSense AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven architecture from data hackathons while solving a direct academic pain point for students and faculty.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight medical interview simulation platform using computer vision for basic posture and emergency response training.
ideas.title: MediSim Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings genuinely hard engineering and hardware/camera integration into a 12-hour sprint, setting the project apart from standard CRUD apps.
